body_markdown:
[Genshin Impact](https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/) is an anime-style open-world action RPG game developed by HoYoverse and has grown into a massive cultural phenomenon since its launch in 2020. It has one of the most robust fandom and original character (OC) communities in gaming, driven by a massive roster of characters with charming designs, unique concepts and a gacha system that lets players unlock random characters and weapons.


If you’re a Traveler who loves creating your own Genshin OC inspired by Hu Tao or Zhongli, **[Redbean](https://www.redbean.ai/)** is a mobile sandbox and Genshin Impact character maker that takes an OC beyond character concept art: bring it to life as a playable character, and lets you build entire crossover worlds as your own version of Genshin Impact.

##


Genshin Impact Character Guide: Things You Need To Know


#


As of September 2026, *Genshin Impact* has roughly[~120 playable characters](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Character/List) , including the[Traveler](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Traveler) , who can switch elements depending on the region visited. In Genshin, you play as the **Traveler** –[Aether](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/aether-kqhnrjjj8xl0) or[Lumine](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/lumine-0uhjxtajmbb5) , searching across Teyvat’s seven nations for a twin sibling who was separated from you on arrival. Each nation is tied to one of the seven elements and watched over by its own Archon, and the main quest opens up nation by nation as new regions release, most recently Snezhnaya, with each new nation typically bringing its own small wave of Genshin Impact OC ideas modeled after it.


Most Genshin characters are built around three fixed things: one of Teyvat’s **seven major nations** , an element or *Vision* , and a weapon type: sword, claymore, polearm, bow, or catalyst. From there, personality and backstory usually tie back into whatever that nation’s current story arc is about. If you’re using the Genshin Impact character guide as a reference before designing your own OC, that’s actually the template the game itself follows: a nation, an element, a weapon, and a role within the story. Most fan-made OCs go through similar steps: building an identity and backstory first, then a visual and outfit layer that reflects that identity, and only then locking in the nation, element, weapon, and kit that seamlessly integrate them into the game’s storyline.


##


Why Genshin’s OC and Fanart Scene Keeps Growing


#


Genshin Impact online community and platforms like Reddit and Pinterest are filled with a massive volume of cosplay, fan art, fan fiction and original characters (OCs). This is a core part of its culture and is driven by a mix of good character design, fantasy world-building and developer support. The game’s anime-inspired art direction gives every character a distinct visual identity, and each one also carries a rich backstory, skills, and relationships to the rest of the cast. The story itself leaves real gaps: the Traveler’s sibling, the true shape of the Fatui, what the Tsaritsa actually wants, which fans fill in with their own theories and characters.


Some Travelers build Genshin-style character cards to show off stats and backstory at a glance. Others use Genshin Impact OC maker tools to design an OC from scratch, write its persona, and slot it into a ship, OC x canon or canon x canon, like[Zhongli](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/zhongli-morax-oyj98yni6rkx) and[Childe](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/tartaglia-childe-ajax-wbdjl94guy30) or Alhaitham and Kaveh. For chatting or roleplaying with a favorite like[Venti](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/venti-barbatos-4vdo5es118mo) or[Raiden](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/raiden-ei-9edxf110lcc9) , a Genshin Impact character.ai chat is also an option. None of them, though, bring you a character you can actually play as, watch move around, or build a real Genshin Impact OC ideas-driven world with.

Redbean: A Genshin Impact Character Maker That Brings Your OC To Life

**Most Genshin Impact character maker** tools stop at an illustration: pick a base template or draw from scratch, customize the outfit, download the image. You can give your Genshin OC a name, backstory and kit concept, but it still exists just as a sketch or image.


*Redbean* is built to fill that gap – it’s a free-to-play mobile sandbox that brings your own characters to life: **turn your Genshin OC or any Genshin characters you love into living pixel characters** , and actually **play around with them** in a world you shape yourself. Your OC can now live alongside[Yumemizuki Mizuki](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/yumemizuki-mizuki-urpxlr419yod) , Zhongli or[Hu Tao](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/hu-tao-jj8um1ow5hll) , you can chat directly with them, build relationships and even build your own Genshin-inspired AU.

- **Shape the town/world yourself:** build a whole town just from your imagination – design it in any theme within a few worlds, style your own buildings and create all kinds of furniture by sketch, description, or photo. You can **create multiple towns,** each with its own story, NPCs, and lore, so a Snezhnaya-themed town and Liyue-themed town can function like nations—much like in the game—with lore and rules of your own making.
- **Explore other towns, or build a multiverse:** visit other players’ towns through the Explore tab, or mix your Genshin cast with characters from a completely different fandom, Zhongli sharing a town with Azure from Forsaken, or Astro from Dandy’s World, for instance.


##


FAQ


#


###


What’s the main story of Genshin Impact, and what’s the most popular fan theory about lore?


#


You play as the Traveler, searching for a twin sibling separated from you on arrival in Teyvat, a world of seven nations, each ruled by an elemental god called an Archon. The current arc centers on Snezhnaya, which opened in[the latest version](https://game8.co/games/Genshin-Impact/archives/596528) , and the Tsaritsa, the Cryo Archon behind the Fatui. One of the fandom’s most repeated theories is that Celestia, the Heavenly Principles governing the whole world, turns out to be the real antagonist behind everything the Tsaritsa has done, not the Tsaritsa herself.


###


Who is the Tsaritsa?


#


[Genshin Impact Tsaritsa](https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Tsaritsa) is the Cryo Archon and ruler of Snezhnaya, the mysterious figure behind the Fatui and one of the story’s two overarching antagonists. She was finally shown in the Sudden Snow trailer in June 2026, but as of September 2026, she still isn’t a playable character. Community leaks point to a Version 7.3 debut sometime in early 2027, so recreating her as a playable character in a Genshin Impact character maker is currently the only way to actually play as her.


###


Can I collect all Genshin Impact characters?


#


**Practically, no.** You can only obtain new characters in Genshin Impact through Wishing – the game’s gacha system, limited-Time banners or specific story quests and events. So it’s nearly impossible for you to get ALL characters in-game unless you are willing to spend an enormous amount of real-world money. However, you can recreate all your favorite Genshin characters in Redbean Character Maker and gather them in one place – it’s a playground where you can freely build, interact and chat with your beloved characters in a text-based roleplay experience.


###


Which Genshin Impact character gets the most fanart and OC inspiration?


#


In Genshin communities, characters like[Ganyu](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/ganyu-h6nb3lc2rw3r) , Raiden Shogun, Hu Tao, Zhongli, and Tartaglia have consistently been among the most-drawn characters since the early years of the game, and that popularity carries over directly into how often they show up in Genshin Impact OC ideas or ship inspiration.


###


How do I create a Genshin Impact OC from scratch?


#


Start with the same three building blocks the game uses: a nation, an element, and a weapon type. From there,[community guides on HoYoLAB](https://www.hoyolab.com/article/30505123) recommend settling on a design motif, an object or symbol worked into the outfit, then researching the real-world culture that nation draws from for fashion reference, rather than making hair or eye color match the element, which the official cast rarely does either. Once the design is set, a Genshin Impact character maker like Redbean is what turns that sketch into something you can actually play as.


###


Is there any official Genshin Impact character maker or card generator?


#


**No** . HoYoverse hasn’t released any Genshin OC maker or character creation tool. The closest official features are a Player Card, which arranges characters you’ve already unlocked, and Miliastra Wonderland’s Manekin avatar, a generic customizable avatar rather than a way to turn your own OC into something playable and able to interact with Zhongli or Hu Tao.


*Redbean isn’t affiliated with HoYoverse. It’s a place for fans to build their own version of the characters they love.*


###


What is Redbean? Can I make other characters besides Genshin Impact characters?


#


[Redbean](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/free-cozy-life-sim-with-your-own-characters) is a mobile sandbox (free-to-play on iOS and Android) where you create or recreate characters, drop them into a pixel town you build, and actually play out a story with them. It isn’t limited to one fandom: your Genshin cast can share a town with original characters or with characters from a completely different series, like The Amazing Digital Circus or Animal Hospital.

**Yes** . Redbean turns a photo or a screenshot into a pixel character the same way it would a sketch, so an OC idea you can’t draw yourself still becomes something playable, with a persona, a town, and other characters to talk to.
